Name: Healthy Fats
Details: Primary energy source. Emphasize monounsaturated (olive oil, avocado, nuts) and saturated from quality sources (butter, coconut, fatty fish, eggs, grass-fed meat). Avoid industrial seed oils.

Name: Protein
Details: Adequate protein at every meal for satiety, muscle maintenance, and metabolic health. Aim for roughly palm-sized portions of protein-rich food per meal (adjust to body size & activity).

Name: Minimal Carbohydrates
Details: Keep net carbs low by focusing on non-starchy vegetables. Typical target for many on this style of eating: under 50g net carbs/day (often 20-30g for stricter keto). Track if desired.

Name: Whole Foods First
Details: Base meals on real foods: meat, fish, eggs, vegetables, healthy oils, nuts, full-fat dairy. Minimize packaged keto products that are highly processed.

Name: Electrolytes & Hydration
Details: Low-carb diets increase sodium and fluid loss initially. Salt food liberally, consider bone broth, and ensure magnesium & potassium from food or supplements if needed.

Name: Individualization
Details: Portions and exact macros vary by age, sex, activity level, goals, and metabolic health. This plan provides structure and food quality; adjust quantities.

Name: Protein target
Details: 1.6-2.2 g per kg body weight (or ~20-35% of calories)

Name: Fat target
Details: Remainder of calories after protein & carbs (often 60-75% of calories on stricter low-carb)

Name: Net Carbohydrates target
Details: 20-50 g per day (or under 10% of calories) depending on goals & tolerance

Name: Fiber
Details: From non-starchy vegetables; helps satiety and gut health

Name: Disclaimer
Details: This meal planner is for general informational and educational purposes only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare provider or registered dietitian before making significant dietary changes.
